Each lever is its gap to its band in targets.json, summed over the shifts of the window: a shift inside its band adds nothing, and the cost inside the bands is shown apart, at standard, outside the total.
A yearly figure is this period's rate, period-to-date dollars per production day x the post's production days a year, never a shift's or a day's own.

Whole dollars that add up: each shift of each production day prints its nearest dollar, its lines sharing it by the largest remainder, and every day, window and line is its shifts' whole dollars added up.
